presentation.label: LFO RND
presentation.summary: A second LFO page: two random modifiers per sound, each offsetting a chosen parameter by a new random amount on every note.
presentation.overview: LFO RND adds a page behind the LFO page key: press LFO again to reach it. It holds two random modifiers per sound. Each has a destination (DS1, DS2), one of sixteen parameters taken from stock's LFO destination list (the eight machine parameters, FIN, STA, FRQ, RES, DEC, PAN, DEL and REV), and a depth (DP1, DP2), 0 to 64 in sixteen steps. On every note trig each modifier draws a random offset between -depth and +depth for its destination, clamped to the parameter's range and held until the next note, on top of p-locks, slides and LFO 1. The settings are kept in the sound through core-ar2's mod storage. It is rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0004-lfo-rnd; from 1.2 its page and knobs go through core-ar2's page tables (core_pages, core_params, core_view_pages) instead of detours of its own.
highlights: Two random modifiers per sound, each with its own destination and depth.
Sixteen destinations from stock's LFO list; depth 0 is stock behaviour.
A new value on every note, held until the next one.
Saved with the sound in core-ar2 mod storage.
usage: Use a build containing LFO RND. Open the LFO page on a voice track and press the LFO page key again: LFO RND shows DS1 and DS2 on knobs A and B, DP1 and DP2 on E and F.
Turn DS1: the destination list opens. Pick FRQ and press YES, then turn DP1 to 32.
Play trigs on that track: the filter cutoff moves to a new random value on every note. Turn DP1 to 0: the notes play as stock again. Press LFO once more to go back to the LFO page.

access.location: LFO page key, pressed a second time on a voice track: the LFO RND page.
steps: Select a voice track (not the FX track).
Press the LFO page key, then press it again: LFO RND.
Press LFO once more to return to the LFO page.

controls.name: DS1 (knob A, LFO RND page)
controls.doc: Random modifier 1's destination: opens stock's LFO destination list, limited to sixteen entries (the eight machine parameters, FIN, STA, FRQ, RES, DEC, PAN, DEL, REV). YES confirms.

controls.name: DP1 (knob E, LFO RND page)
controls.doc: Random modifier 1's depth: sixteen steps from 0 to 64. Each note offsets DS1's parameter by a random amount between -DP1 and +DP1. 0 is off.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only. 1.2.0 reaches its page and knobs through core-ar2's page tables (core_pages, core_params, core_view_pages; core-ar2 0.4 and later; Modwerk's base is core-ar2 0.7). 1.1 and earlier detoured those page routines itself and does not link with core-ar2 0.4 or later.
Voice tracks only: the FX track has no LFO RND page.
DS1, DS2, DP1 and DP2 cannot be p-locked, scene-locked or modulated; they are sound settings (lfo-rnd 1.3 adds that, but needs core-ar2 0.9).
Needs core-ar2's mod storage: one 16-bit sound field (lfo_rnd_cfg). On stock firmware, or a build without this module, the sound plays without the random offsets.
Sounds saved by lfo-rnd 1.0 (which kept the settings in the sound's parameter word 0) keep them; the first edit moves them into mod storage.
Hooks the audio interrupt next to Loop Sync's site (different bytes); the pair has not been run together.

claims: ui:LFO page key second press (LFO RND page, core_view_pages)

load.display: Small: a storage read per voice trig and one random draw per modifier at each note's start
load.conditions: Static: the sequencer interrupt reads the sound's field once per voice trig; the audio interrupt draws and clamps at most two offsets when a note starts and otherwise adds the held offsets. The rest runs on UI edits and drawing. On a unit with all eleven rytm2_mods ports on core-ar2 0.10 (T133, lfo-rnd 1.2 among them) the whole set idled at CPU 80 % and peaked at 96 % with notes on eight voice tracks; this module's share was not measured on its own.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports: Hardware, Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, 2026-10-21 (runs T22, T23 and T25): with core-ar2 0.4 and all eleven rytm2_mods ports, LFO RND's page and four knobs went through core_pages and core_params (P4A4, the source before the page-key list) and every README test step passed; the page-key list through core_view_pages passed (Q4A4); core's page step and title (U4A4, the bytes of rytm2_mods v1.3, which this folder holds) stepped LFO, LFO RND, LFO with the header following.
limitations: Not yet run from this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7): the unit runs used core-ar2 0.4.
P4A4 ran the source before the page-key list (rytm2_mods 7ff47d7); U4A4 ran this folder's bytes, but only the page step and header were checked on it.
P4A4: .syx 1c0311697543789316c10dbbbfa78b9a717a180eb26611f2f0d1b732a428d65c. U4A4: .syx 18681f8709242b9d3c5117335a81cd5659ea01c583e3e8477d536e379517b785. Firmware was not read back from the device.
Random offsets per note were seen on 1.0's unit run and read from the module's tables on 1.3; their spread was not measured on 1.2.

tests.summary: Hardware: lfo-rnd 1.2 on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, with core-ar2 0.4 and the other rytm2_mods ports (P4A4, Q4A4, U4A4, 2026-10-21): the page through core's page tables, its list and depths, offsets per note, settings kept through save and power cycle. Modwerk's package linked with core-ar2 0.7 is byte-identical to rytm2_mods v1.3's release object linked with it. Emulator on the Modwerk base (LR12): page, list, DS1 and DP1. Not yet on a unit with Modwerk's base.
